title: Code Studio
tagline: Architect, refactor, and test software with AST precision and zero-trust safety

cases.title: AST Refactor & Clean Architecture
cases.description: Eliminate duplicate types, optimize imports, and enforce clean layered interfaces across modules.
cases.prompt: Analyze current TypeScript modules, identify coupling antipatterns, and propose an AST-safe refactoring diff with zero runtime regression.

cases.title: Generate Pytest Suite with Boundaries
cases.description: Synthesize comprehensive unit and regression tests with 100% boundary assertion coverage.
cases.prompt: Write a comprehensive pytest test suite for the current module covering edge cases, empty payloads, and exception branches.
cases.sample_output:
```python
import pytest
from core.service import DataProcessor

def test_process_empty_payload_raises():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match='Payload cannot be empty'):
        DataProcessor().process({})
```
Generated 8 test cases with 100% boundary coverage.

cases.title: Zero-Trust Security & Vuln Audit
cases.description: Static AST audit to scan for arbitrary command injection, SSRF, and credential leaks.
cases.prompt: Run a security audit on all API route handlers, verify authorization guards, and check for unsanitized subprocess calls.
cases.sample_output: Audit complete: 0 critical vulnerabilities found. 2 warnings addressed: sanitized user input in shell subprocess execution.

cases.title: High-Throughput Concurrency Review
cases.description: Diagnose deadlocks, race conditions, and memory leaks in asynchronous execution loops.
cases.prompt: Review async worker pipelines for lock contention, thread starvation, and backpressure handling under 10k req/s load.
cases.sample_output: Identified lock contention on GlobalStateMutex. Migrated to lock-free channels with bounded queues.
